newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ SPORT - Rain holds up England tour opener.
newsitem.headline: NZ SPORT - Rain holds up England tour opener.

text.p: NEW PLYMOUTH, Jan 10 - Rain delayed the start of play in England's opening cricket tour match against the Academy 11 at Pukekura Park on Friday, NZPA reported.
Steady rain began falling about mid-morning. After a brief respite around 40 minutes before the scheduled noon start the rain became heavier.
Covers have been kept on the pitch and the bowlers' run-ups. Although prospects for play were bleak, a steady stream of spectators came into the ground.
Umpires Brent Bowden and Evan Watkin could not make a decision on a new start time until the rain stopped.
With Cyclone Drena making its way down the North Island prospects of much if any play today were slim.
If the match is rained off, the English tourists will only have two matches as preparation for the first test against New Zealand, starting in Auckland on January 24.

They will play a New Zealand Selection in a four-day game starting in Palmerston North on Monday, and another four-dayer against Northern Districts beginning in Hamilton on January 18. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 473-4746
